levels.label: Public workflow selection
levels.allowed_claim: The case uses the public, dependency-free safe-tool-guards workflow and names its two allowlisted contract files.
levels.forbidden_inference: The selected workflow represents the whole workbench catalog or a production deployment.

levels.label: Preview and install
levels.status_display: Two clean targets, explicit apply, no silent overwrite
levels.allowed_claim: Generic and Codex dry-runs are non-mutating; explicit apply copies two allowlisted files and a second apply is refused when both files exist.
levels.forbidden_inference: The installer registered a host, contacted a provider, or changed files outside the explicit target root.

levels.label: Portable projection
levels.status_display: Native projections share destinations and hashes
levels.allowed_claim: The generic and Codex projections have matching relative destinations, action counts, and file hashes while provider registration remains manual.
levels.forbidden_inference: Matching files prove equivalent model decisions, tool calls, host hooks, or quality outcomes.

levels.label: Receipt-scoped recovery
levels.status_display: Owned files recover; modified and unrelated files stay protected
levels.allowed_claim: Recovery previews and removes unchanged receipt-owned files, preserves an unrelated sentinel, and blocks when a receipt-owned file was modified.
levels.forbidden_inference: The case proves rollback of host registration or provider runtime state.

levels.label: Host runtime equivalence
levels.allowed_claim: The runtime comparison records why generic and Codex host behavior cannot be compared under the selected policy.
levels.forbidden_inference: The portable files execute identically in generic and Codex hosts.

levels.label: Local material package
levels.status_display: Case study, claim ledger, preview, short copy, and page source
levels.allowed_claim: A local candidate packet contains the evidence-bound case, reviewed binary preview, short description, and no-auth page source.
levels.forbidden_inference: The packet is hosted, public, or posted to a destination.
